title: Veranda’s modular platform applied across many industries
body: Built for companies that move goods, the Veranda platform is designed to sit inside carrier, distributor, and integrator programs, not to replace them.

cards.title: Home, small-office & professional delivery
cards.body: Groceries, parcels, Rx, and confidential documents or devices, received without a delivery window and with a record of the receiver.

cards.title: Regulated cold chain & clinical Custody
cards.body: Pharmaceuticals, diagnostics and clinical tests, and other healthcare deliveries, received and maintained at 2–8°C custody from distributor to patient or lab.

cards.title: Field service & industrial parts
cards.body: Time-critical parts (e.g. contractor supplies, utilities, auto, optical, transport) delivered to technicians overnight so routes start loaded, not spent driving back to the shop.

cards.title: Special access & asset control
cards.body: Timed, logged access to a space or asset for applications such as real estate (lockboxes and scheduled access) and waste management receptacles.
